Services

Every part of the roof

Slate, tile and flat roofing, chimneys and leadwork, for homes, extensions and new builds. Pick the job and we'll tell you how we do it.

Roof repairs

Leaks, slipped tiles, storm damage and worn ridges fixed properly, with a straight answer on whether a repair is worth it.

Find out more

Re-roofing and new roofs

Full roof replacement in natural slate, slate-effect or concrete tile, with new membrane, battens and leadwork. 25-year guarantee.

Find out more

Flat roofs

GRP fibreglass and single-ply flat roofs for extensions, garages and dormers. Seamless, long-lasting and guaranteed for 25 years.

Find out more

Chimney repairs and rebuilds

Repointing, rebuilding, new flaunching and pots, and taking redundant stacks down below the roofline. Done while we are up there.

Find out more

Leadwork

Flashings, valleys, back gutters and soakers, hand-dressed in the right code of lead. The detail that decides whether a roof leaks.

Find out more

Dormer and loft-conversion roofs

The roofing side of loft conversions. Flat GRP dormer tops, tiled or clad cheeks, and the new roof tied back into the old one so it never leaks at the join.

Find out more

Roof lanterns and Velux windows

Roof windows, flat rooflights and lanterns supplied and fitted, with the flashing and weatherproofing done by the roofer rather than left to chance.

Find out more

Fascias, soffits and guttering

Rotten timber fascias replaced with uPVC, soffits ventilated, gutters realigned so the water goes where it should.

Find out more

Storm damage and insurance work

Emergency make-safe repairs, photos and a report for your insurer, and the permanent repair once the claim is agreed. We cover insurance work.

Find out more

New build and commercial roofing

Slate and tile roofs for new builds, developments and commercial buildings. Programmed, site-safe and finished to drawings.

Find out more

24/7

Emergency roof repairs

Water coming in, tiles off, a chimney moving. Call any time and we'll make it safe.

Our guarantee

Put in writing, every job

Every roof we build or repair comes with a workmanship guarantee from Oakwell Roofing Ltd. We put it in writing when the job is finished, so you know exactly what is covered and for how long.

All guarantees cover our workmanship and are provided by Oakwell Roofing Ltd. They are not insurance-backed.

Read what the guarantee covers
  • 25 years
    New roof (new slate or tile)
  • 25 years
    Flat roof (GRP or single-ply)
  • 15 years
    Re-roof using reclaimed slate or tile
  • 1 year
    Repairs
